entities.summary: Abel Paz was a Spanish anarchist and historian who fought in the Spanish Civil War. He wrote multiple volumes on anarchist history, including Durruti in the Spanish Revolution, a biography of the influential anarchist Buenaventura Durruti. He kept the anarchist tradition throughout his life, including time in Francoist Spain's jails and multiple decades in exile in France (1953-1978).
